summary.content:
Today's selection covers 96 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 61 on Artificial Intelligence and 13 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Anthropic’s C.E.O. Says It Could Grow by 80 Times This Year
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Live updates from Elon Musk and Sam Altman’s court battle over the future of OpenAI
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, BBC Technology, SecurityWeek, The Verge, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 51 articles published in the last 24 hours
